scope: Full Rust release only: fresh full-tool/frontend/backend PGO, tools, docs, MSI, applicable backends and Arm64EC; original extracted-distribution qualification. No IronRDP replay.

additional_repeats.condition: Only after four-CPU control 38869758791/116880180878 completes and qualifies
additional_repeats.reason: User requested a repeat to investigate the unexpectedly high first 16-CPU production time
additional_repeats.identity: Independent fresh workflow run; retain both observations by run ID, with per-run VM and attempt identifiers unchanged

allocation: Logical CPU affinity and bootstrap/Cargo/CMake worker counts set together. x64 has only 8 physical cores / 16 logical CPUs, not 16 physical cores.
primary: Production wall time from before opt-dist helper construction through completed full distribution; includes fresh training/merges/builds/packaging, excludes setup/qualification/uploads/cleanup.
secondary: Actual successful job wall time and exclusive production phase breakdown; queue/offline waiting reported separately.
controls: Fresh run-specific physical roots, Cargo homes and profiles per cell; no compiler or profile cache reuse. Serialize within each machine; allow independent machines in parallel.
analysis: Compare 4->16 on each machine and 4->16->32 on GB300 using only matching source, tools, flags and qualified results. Report measured ratios and the 360-minute hosted threshold, not a guaranteed hosted-VM projection. Cross-machine ratios are not CPU scaling.
qualification: Verify full manifests, executed backend profiles, native compiler/linker/librarian hashes, explicit Rust PGO/ThinLTO flags, CPU accounting and common extracted tests.
limitations: Initial single-pass scaling pilots with fixed order, no confidence intervals. Prior Microsoft-PGO releases had Rust cross-crate ThinLTO off and cannot serve as this recipe's four-CPU controls. No larger GitHub-hosted runner was measured.
failure_policy: Failed, timed-out or unqualified cells are excluded; dependent cells stop rather than reuse partial output. Offline GB300 may queue for at most GitHub's queue limit; relaunch fresh if the queue expires.
